method: Independent block inventory from accepted Markdown; decoded actual TeX paragraph bodies, all table rows and cells, and every editorial comment. Full non-whitespace Unicode sequences also checked in extracted PDF prose after removal of running matter and normalization of Xpdf soft-hyphen encoding to the original literal hyphen.
formatting_changes: Both documents use Ligatures=TeXOff to preserve the masters' literal punctuation in extracted PDF text.

Seven-column adjective tables use stacked singular/plural panels at readable 10.5pt type. The six-column nominal diagnostic table uses linked noun/stem/model and noun/oblique-form panels. Repeated case or noun columns are furniture; reconstruction reproduces every original coordinate, header and cell. Other tables retain their original columns.
The complete exact source reading and new account use the reading style; short examples stay with their translations.
Cook labels remain with their prompts; final page-specific repairs are recorded in the page review.
Line wrapping, emphasis commands and page furniture differ from Markdown; linguistic text and punctuation are preserved.

documents.source_notes: All source-note paragraphs and apparatus tables included in the complete block/cell counts above.
